services.name: Polk Academy Summer Camps
services.desc: Since 1998, Polk Academy has invited campers graduating the 3rd, 4th, and 5th grade to learn about life in the 19th century through crafts, activities, and living history presentations. From wood graining to candle making to water balloon war reenactments, the Polk Home’s seminal summer camp has something for everyone. Join us in the summer of 2026 for the following camps: Tennessee Time Traveler Camp, Gold Rush Camp, History Detective Camp! The “click here to register” button will take you to the registration and payment for each individual camp. Calling all curious kids!
